title: Colony and Horizon
author: Orsen Underhill
blurb: Wendell Yarrow, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
